title: Start Day of the Early-Duty Month Credit and the TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member Enrollment
content:
**Ledger adjustment ruling - TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, TRICARE Reserve Select.**

The day the early-duty month credit is counted from follows the purchaser's TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member enrollment: where that enrollment is applied or active and its effective date falls inside the most recently paid month, the early-duty month credit is counted from that effective date; where that enrollment is applied or active and its effective date falls before the most recently paid month began, the early-duty month credit is counted from the first day of the month; otherwise the early-duty month credit is counted from the plan's termination date.

The enrollment is the purchaser's own enrollment in the TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member tier, with the status and effective date its TRICARE Prime record shows. The most recently paid month is the coverage month of the bill the latest posted premium payment on the TRICARE Reserve Select plan settles. "Otherwise" takes in every remaining case: no such enrollment, an enrollment in any status other than applied or active, and an applied or active enrollment whose effective date falls after that month ended.

## Applying the ruling (hypothetical: most recently paid month June, 30 days; plan termination date 14 June)

| TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member enrollment | Effective date | Counted from |
|---|---|---|
| active | 9 June | 9 June |
| applied | 1 June | 1 June |
| applied | 20 May | 1 June, the first day of the month |
| active | 3 July | 14 June, the termination date |
| disenrolled | 9 June | 14 June, the termination date |
| none on record | - | 14 June, the termination date |
